title: DHP series + oral Bordetella
notes: Sunriver medical record: healthy puppy exam; DHP series vaccination, oral Bordetella (1-year), and pyrantel dewormer administered. Clinical weight 4.69 lb. No allergies or medications recorded at this exam; current status unverified. Dose numbers unspecified. This corrects the earlier September 11 entry.

title: Fecal results and clinic assessment
notes: Sample collected September 17. Roundworm, hookworm, whipworm, flea tapeworm, taeniid tapeworm, Cystoisospora, and Giardia antigens negative. Eimeria oocysts present. In her September 18 assessment, Dr. Salgo advised no treatment was needed and attributed likely exposure to eating rabbit feces. This is the dated clinical assessment, not new advice.

title: Off to Amy's
notes: Care handoff. The care guide PDF and the signed authorization letter travel with him.

title: DHP + Lepto Vaccine - Series
notes: Sunriver medical record: DHP + Lepto Vaccine - Series administered, Vanguard/Zoetis, batch E308271. Dose number unspecified. Clinical weight 7.0 lb; separate owner report that day was 7.5 lb. Booster advised in four weeks. Nervous in the busy treatment area; did better in a calmer area.

title: Planned vaccine review — administration pending
notes: Planned November 1 vaccine review; administration pending visit record. Sunriver recommended DHP, Lepto, and rabies, with an October 30–November 2 booster window (October 27 email). November 2 Sunriver appointment was canceled October 29. The October 26 portal reminder was automated, not an appointment. No rabies administration or later series completion is verified.
